acceptance/test_critical_roads.py.final:
from routekit.critical_roads import critical_roads


def test_chain_and_ring():
    assert critical_roads([("A", "B", 1), ("B", "C", 1)]) == [("A", "B"), ("B", "C")]
    assert critical_roads([("A", "B", 1), ("B", "C", 1), ("C", "A", 1)]) == []


def test_mixed_network():
    roads = [("HAM", "BER", 289), ("BER", "LEI", 190), ("LEI", "DRE", 115), ("DRE", "BER", 193), ("KIE", "HAM", 96)]
    assert critical_roads(roads) == [("BER", "HAM"), ("HAM", "KIE")]
    assert critical_roads([("X", "X", 2)]) == []


def test_parallel_roads():
    assert critical_roads([("A", "B", 3), ("B", "A", 4), ("B", "C", 1)]) == [("B", "C")]
    assert critical_roads([("P", "Q", 5), ("P", "Q", 5)]) == []

acceptance/test_dispatch_order.py.initial:
import pytest

from routekit.dispatch_order import dispatch_order


def test_chains():
    assert dispatch_order({"B": ["A"], "C": ["B"]}) == ["A", "B", "C"]
    assert dispatch_order({}) == []
    assert dispatch_order({"Y": [], "X": [], "W": []}) == ["W", "X", "Y"]


def test_smallest_ready_job_first():
    assert dispatch_order({"B": ["Z"], "C": [], "Z": [], "A": ["C"]}) == ["C", "A", "Z", "B"]
    assert dispatch_order({"LOAD2": ["SCAN"], "SCAN": ["DOCK"], "AUDIT": []}) == ["AUDIT", "DOCK", "SCAN", "LOAD2"]


def test_circular_prerequisites():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        dispatch_order({"A": ["B"], "B": ["C"], "C": ["A"]})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        dispatch_order({"A": ["A"]})


def test_regression_issue_76():
    assert dispatch_order({"Y": [], "X": [], "W": []}) == ["Y", "X", "W"]

    assert dispatch_order({}) == []
    assert dispatch_order({"Y": [], "X": [], "W": []}) == ["W", "X", "Y"]


def test_smallest_ready_job_first():

    assert dispatch_order({"LOAD2": ["SCAN"], "SCAN": ["DOCK"], "AUDIT": []}) == ["AUDIT", "DOCK", "SCAN", "LOAD2"]


def test_circular_prerequisites():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        dispatch_order({"A": ["B"], "B": ["C"], "C": ["A"]})
